tables.name: ui_working_copies
columns: owner_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_user_profiles(local_user_profile_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(target_type) BETWEEN 1 AND 64)
target_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(target_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128)
scope_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(scope_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 96)
draft_contract_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(draft_contract_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 96)
base_revision_token TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(base_revision_token) BETWEEN 1 AND 256)
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
last_checkpoint_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: payload_json and dirty_paths_json must pass LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson plus WorkingCopyContractRegistry validation before write
canonical UTF-8 payload bytes must be <=262144
rows are recoverable UI intent only and are excluded from every authoritative domain query/report/count

delete_policy: explicit discard or expiry cleanup may delete the recoverable row; metadata-only audit/command receipts remain and never contain draft body
